dependencies.name: JetBrains Mono (font)
dependencies.version: assets/fonts/JetBrainsMono-*.ttf (Regular, Medium, Bold, ExtraBold and their italics)
dependencies.provenance: SHIPPED ASSETS. Licence read from the fonts' own name table (nameID 13)

dependencies.name: Cousine (font)
dependencies.version: assets/fonts/Cousine-Regular.ttf, Cousine-Regular-cut.ttf; also embedded in src/Embedded/FontCousineRegular.h
dependencies.provenance: SHIPPED ASSETS and EMBEDDED. The two shipped files carry DIFFERENT licence strings in their own name tables -- the '-cut' build says OFL-1.1, the stock one Apache-2.0. Both permit commercial redistribution; the discrepancy is recorded rather than smoothed over

dependencies.name: ProFont IIx (font)
dependencies.licence: ProFont Distribution licence (freeware, SQ Software / Carl R. Osterwald 1997)
dependencies.provenance: SHIPPED ASSET and EMBEDDED. NOT an OSI licence: redistribution is permitted for UNMODIFIED copies only, the ProFont Distribution package may not itself be sold, but it may be distributed free alongside a product that is sold. This copy is unmodified (261 glyphs, 4 Polish)

dependencies.name: ProFontWindows PL (font) -- MODIFIED ProFont, licence unresolved
dependencies.licence: ProFont Distribution licence (freeware) -- but see provenance
dependencies.provenance: SHIPPED ASSET, and MARKED UNSAFE DELIBERATELY. The file names itself 'ProFontWindows 2.3' internally but carries 296 glyphs including all 18 Polish diacritics, against 261 and 4 in the stock ProFontIIx here -- i.e. it is a MODIFIED copy. ProFont's licence permits redistribution of UNMODIFIED copies only, so a commercial build has no grant for this file. Settle it (drop the file, obtain permission, or replace it with an OFL face) and flip this field; until then a store build aborts here on purpose

dependencies.name: IBM Plex Sans and Plex Mono (fonts)
dependencies.provenance: EMBEDDED in src/Embedded/FontPlexSans.h and FontPlexMono.h. NOTE: both headers point at 'papers/ibm-plex-license.txt', which does not exist in this repository
